subject: VaultTech demo — access runbook, procurement gating, and SE attendance
messages:
From: Alex Peters <alex.peters@vaulttech.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@vaulttech.com, maya.singh@vaulttech.com
Date: Mon, 08 Nov 2026 09:13:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood SE demo — access and procurement questions

Thanks for the quick setup call earlier. We're excited to see the SE walkthrough next week. Two quick items to align on before we lock the calendar:

1) Attendee list: our infra engineer (Maya), security lead (cc'd), and one procurement contact will be on the invite. If an SE needs to bring an engineer, can you confirm who from Redwood will join?

2) VPN/console access: for the portion where we run a short live workload, our security team requires a brief runbook and an access form filled out (IP allowlist, duration, account used). Can you send a runbook and the access template we should populate?

If we can get the runbook + template by EOD Wednesday (PST), procurement can triage the internal approvals and we can confirm a 60-min slot on Nov 10/11.

Alex
Alex Peters
Platform Architect — VaultTech

From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Peters <alex.peters@vaulttech.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, procurement@vaulttech.com
Date: Mon, 08 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood SE demo — access and procurement questions

Alex — thanks. Attaching a concise runbook and our standard access form (attached). Quick notes:

- SE coverage: I'll join as lead SE. Ben Carter (Solutions Eng) will also attend to help with the live workload and answer infra-level questions.
- Runbook: redwood-demo-runbook.pdf includes a 10-minute live workload plan (no persistent creds required), expected network flows, and rollback steps.
- Access form: access-form-template.xlsx — please populate the "network" and "duration" fields; we recommend a 30-minute window for live testing inside the 60-min session.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Wed Nov 10: 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Thu Nov 11: 11:00–12:00

If procurement needs DocuSign for an NDA or SOW pre-approval, loop Ben and me and we can escalate.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: procurement@vaulttech.com
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Alex Peters <alex.peters@vaulttech.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Nov 2026 12:41:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood SE demo — access and procurement questions

Hi team — quick procurement note: VaultTech requires a one-page statement of access responsibilities for vendor-run demos (who will have access, data handling during the session, and post-demo retention). Can Redwood provide a one-page SOR (statement of responsibilities) and a pointer to your SOC2 report or compliance page? We can fast-track with that.

Procurement Team
VaultTech

From: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: procurement@vaulttech.com, Alex Peters <alex.peters@vaulttech.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 08 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood SE demo — access and procurement questions

Hi — adding the one-page SOR and compliance pointer. See attached SOW draft excerpt and a compliance link. Short summary:

- SOR: Redwood SEs will use ephemeral demo accounts; no customer PII will be persisted. We capture logs for troubleshooting for up to 24 hours and then rotate them per customer policy.
- Compliance: SOC 2 & compliance overview: https://redwood.ai/compliance

I'll also confirm who on our side is authorized to sign a short demo addendum if needed — we can do a limited DocuSign for this demo-only access.

Regards,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Alex Peters <alex.peters@vaulttech.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: maya.singh@vaulttech.com, procurement@vaulttech.com, security.lead@vaulttech.com
Date: Tue, 09 Nov 2026 08:29:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood SE demo — access and procurement questions

Thanks Lauren — that SOR looks fine. Procurement will still need a filled access-form and a completed internal approval by 11/10 11:00 PST to confirm the afternoon slot. Two clarifications from security:

- Can the demo run inside our sandbox VPC rather than Redwood initiating outbound? If so, what minimal network config is required?
- For log access, can Redwood redact IPs in the troubleshooting logs?

If you can answer both quickly I can lock Nov 10 14:00–15:00 PST. If not, we may need to move to Nov 11.

Alex

From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Peters <alex.peters@vaulttech.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: security.lead@vaulttech.com, procurement@vaulttech.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood SE demo — access and procurement questions

Alex — quick answers from the SE side: 

1) Sandbox VPC: Yes — we can run the workload from within your sandbox. Minimal requirements: allow HTTPS outbound to api.redwood.ai on 443 for 10 minutes and add the ephemeral test IP (we'll provide it 1 hour prior) to the allowlist. The runbook has a short network section labelled "Sandbox run" (page 2).

2) Logs: We will redact client IPs and any hostnames you mark as sensitive before sharing. For troubleshooting we keep ephemeral logs for up to 24 hours and can provide a sanitized excerpt to your security team.

Action items from Redwood:
- Karthik: send the ephemeral test IP and a final copy of the access form once VaultTech fills it.
- Lauren: confirm DocuSign signer or confirm demo addendum flow.

If procurement confirms by EOD we can go ahead with Nov 10 14:00–15:00 PST. Otherwise, propose Nov 11 11:00–12:00 PST as backup.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
